scope: One fixed-C exposed f04 transfer: 12 forwards, zero derivatives, 300 seconds including loading; no retry
inert_update_reservation: Immutable helper requires positive quotas; one byte reserved but updates.jsonl is forbidden. No training/update artifact is permitted.

finalization.transfer_pass_requires: fault-free sealed inventory plus independent numerical audit, all four strict original edits and four matching replays

limitations: Cooperative authenticated Windows recording, not an operating-system sandbox.
Partial writes and temporary replacement overlap are counted; already-admitted reserved writes may complete during failure.
Unconfirmed quiescence or failed/hung I/O is INCONCLUSIVE/unsealed; failure receipts may be best-effort.
Overflow preserves a bounded prefix; unread tail is explicitly unknown, never complete output.
Caps count namespace file-content bytes, not RAM, OS buffers, filesystem metadata or external sync copies.
